escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, late morning): the Efeonce office kitchen, from a stool at its island, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at the smooth warm-white matte plaster kitchen wall 2.5 m away, above a run of handle-less deep navy cabinets with a white quartz counter; horizon level, verticals straight. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of the lettering on that wall above the counter — a small line and a large line with its magenta sphere as the period — reproduce it exactly as cut matte navy vinyl letters. On the counter under it: a sleek integrated current-generation espresso machine; a row of five Efeonce mugs reproduced exactly from Image 4 — the white mugs with «Hacer.» and the navy mugs with their word, the thin orbit arc around it and the coloured rim — and the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid DEEP NAVY (#023C70, dark ink blue, never royal blue) desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on the counter beside the mugs, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), satin finish, crisp bevel. LEFT THIRD: Image 3 is the final artwork of a framed «employee of the month» print; hang it at head height as a real print in a slim black frame under glass with a faint reflection, reproduced exactly: the header, the portrait of the woman in her navy Efeonce uniform jacket with the embroidered emblem and the Efeonce lanyard, and her name with its sphere. LIGHT: hard sun from the RIGHT through the glazing crosses the kitchen as a visible shaft; a thin wisp of steam rising from the espresso machine catches it. The centre of the wall stays calm and bare. TRACES OF WORK: a spoon left on a saucer, one mug upside down on a drying mat. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): floor-to-ceiling glazing with slim black frames; smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless pale microcement floor; furniture with clean lines — pale solid-surface or light-oak tables on slim black steel legs, graphite ergonomic mesh chairs, handle-less storage; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic: no reclaimed wood, no brass, no Edison bulbs, no wooden brackets, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2, Image 3 and Image 4 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
